Build a complete, working To-Do List web application using plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

Requirements:
1. Create `index.html`, `style.css`, and `app.js`.
2. Display a task list with a text input and Add button.
3. Allow users to add non-empty tasks.
4. Allow users to mark tasks as complete or incomplete.
5. Allow users to delete tasks.
6. Save tasks in `localStorage` so they survive page refresh.
7. Show a helpful empty-state message when no tasks exist.
8. Use a clean, responsive interface that works on desktop and mobile.
9. Do not use external libraries, frameworks, or a backend.
10. Deliver a working application that can be opened through `index.html`.
